text:
Elena Park: Dropping a fresh mock for RBAC + invite flow + SSO messaging + audit nav. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new-rbac/v1. Please skim and add short comments with tag UX-REVIEW. Main asks below.

Jonah Reyes: Quick UI note: at desktop widths the grid with 6 permission columns is noisy. Suggest showing only top 3 perms and a lightweight "More perms" chevron that expands a detail row. Keeps scanning easier.

Maya Singh: Agreed. Expanded detail should not detach to another DOM container to preserve reading order. Also propose an inline unsaved dot + a global sticky "Save changes to roles" CTA.

Rina Gupta: Invite modal copy tweak: change CTA to "Invite members". For link creation offer presets: 1h, 24h, 7d and a beta "single-use" checkbox (note: single-use will be flagged in the UI as beta). Helper below input: "Separate multiple emails with commas."

Infra Bot: Backend note: expiry presets map to existing params. Single-use will need token invalidation support; flagging as beta is sensible. We'll schedule a DB token-store change next sprint.

Elena Park: SSO toggle: current label is terse. Proposed two-line label: top "Require SSO for sign-in" and muted subtext "Turning on will block password sign-in and may sign out non-SSO sessions." Add an admin confirmation modal that lists affected user groups and requires a checked "I understand".

Jonah Reyes: Add a small warning pill near the toggle when org has non-SSO sessions: "X active sessions may be affected". Clicking it opens details.

A11y Bot: Accessibility checklist: roles grid should use role="table" and each expand control needs aria-expanded + aria-controls. Ensure keyboard order keeps expand and action buttons reachable. Confirmation modal must focus trap and have visible focus styles. Announce success/failure messages with aria-live="polite". Add skip link to jump to filters in the audit view.

Maya Singh: Audit log: switch from infinite scroll modal to cursor-based paging with explicit "Load older" + a "Jump to date" quick picker. This helps investigations where people search by timestamp. We'll add a subtle sticky time-range filter.

Infra Bot: We'll add an index on event_time and a seek endpoint to support jump-to-date. ETA: infra work in next sprint window.

Rina Gupta: UX microcopy: for the undo snackbar use: "Permissions updated 1 Undo" (dismisses after 5s). Error copy: "Failed to save permissions. Try again or contact support."

Jonah Reyes: Analytics: track `invite_modal_open`, `invite_link_created`, `sso_requirement_toggled`, `roles_save_batch` with payloads org_id, actor_id, and changes. Add event names to the spec doc.

Elena Park: I'll update the Figma with the copy and the small spec (API endpoints, event names, a11y checklist). Please add short comments in the file by EOD tomorrow. If no blockers I'll freeze spec Wed AM.

Maya Singh: Will prototype keyboard interactions for expand/save flows.

Infra Bot: No blocking infra concerns except the token-store change for single-use links.

A11y Bot: Reminder: test with keyboard + NVDA/VoiceOver and report missing ARIA in figma comments.

Elena Park: Thanks all 1 tagging as FYI for PM/Eng/A11Y.
